2. BBQ Pinto Beans — Simmer dried beans with onion, smoked paprika, and a ladle o’ barbecue sauce. Cool, then ladle into bowls. They’ll stay hot in an insulated tray or cool in the cooler, both work fine.

3. Triple-Decker Veggie Tray — Layer sliced tomatoes, red onion, and bell pepper in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze o’ lemon. No wilting, no fuss.

Each dish takes ten minutes to assemble once ingredients are prepped, and none needs watchful eyes. Ye can set ’em out and let the guests help themselves while ye keep an eye on the grill.

If ye want to stretch the spread, keep a pot of cheddar popcorn on the side—cheap, filling, and kids love it. Just remember to keep the trays covered so flies don’t board the ship.

Fair winds to ye, and may the barbecue run smooth as calm seas.
